name: Alpine Kräuterwanderung
beschreibung:
The Stubaital is a side valley of the Inntal in Tyrol, about 35 kilometers long, south of Innsbruck, with the five main towns Neustift, Fulpmes, Telfes, Mieders and Schönberg. The coordinates of the entry are located in the front Stubaital near Telfes. In summer, about 850 kilometers of hiking trails lead through the region; among them is the pleasure trail "Stubaier Almkräuter" from Milders to the Auffangalm and Brandstattalm.

The entry describes a guided herb hike with an herb educator and tasting of regional products, duration about four hours, price 55 euros. An assignment to a named, bookable provider was not possible based on publicly accessible official sources.
